The probability of Zone North was raised after the field team observed additional lantern brackets following heavy rain.  A second rusted lantern bracket and, more importantly, a third bracket were seen on the west rock face; the third bracket was marked by mineral lines and stood beside a stone cavity that contained a corroded metal box stamped “T41.”  The presence of these lantern brackets and the associated metal box led the investigators to label Zone North as the probable location of the Hollow Stair with high confidence (see *The Hollow Stair Status Finally Changes*).
